content_sections.text: Other conditions: Candidates employed in Central/ State Government, Autonomous Bodies, PSUs or Government-funded institutions should apply through proper channel. Selected candidates may be required to work in laboratories, service areas, residential/ campus facilities and shifts. Each Post Code represents one vacancy. Mason: Relevant experience in institutional/ residential/ hospital/ commercial buildings.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IOPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IOPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 2 Tradesman (Electrical), 1 Tradesman (Electrical/Electronics), 1 Tradesman (Mechanical/Refrigeration & Air Conditioning), 1 Tradesman (Mason).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IOPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Institute's website) and send it to The Director, Institute of Physics, P.O. Sainik School, Bhubaneswar - 751005, Odisha, by by post, to reach by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for IOPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IOPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 25 years (as on the last date for receipt of applications). Relaxation: rule As per Government of India/DAE rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for IOPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 2 Pay Matrix of the 7th CPC for Tradesman (Electrical), Level 2 Pay Matrix of the 7th CPC for Tradesman (Electrical/Electronics), Level 2 Pay Matrix of the 7th CPC for Tradesman (Mechanical/Refrigeration & Air Conditioning), Level 2 Pay Matrix of the 7th CPC for Tradesman (Mason).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for IOPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SSC/10th with minimum 60% marks or HSC/12th with Science & Mathematics, together with ITI/Trade Certificate of at least one year duration in relevant trade. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for IOPB Recruitment 2026 besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates employed in Central/State Government, Autonomous Bodies, PSUs or Government-funded institutions should apply through proper channel. Selected candidates may be required to work in laboratories, service areas, residential/campus facilities and shifts. Each Post Code represents one vacancy. Separate application must be submitted for each Post Code.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for IOPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Written examination and/or screening. Trade/Skill Test. A Trade Test shall be mandatory. Trade/Skill Test will assess practical knowledge, safety awareness and hands-on proficiency relevant to the advertised trade.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for IOPB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Two years probation, subject to applicable rules.
